justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/inline/HeadlessInlineVisitor.java` and `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/launch/LaunchHeadless.java`. The target package contains only one class and has just one incoming reference (`LaunchHeadless`), while `HeadlessInlineVisitor` depends on central packages `model`, `core`, `util`, `compilation`, and `treevisitor`. Repo-wide reference counts from `rg -l` show those dependency packages are much more widely used (`model` 124 files, `core` 93, `util` 39, `compilation` 14, `treevisitor` 8) than `inline` itself, so `org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.inline` is not a stable package depending on less stable ones.
